limits: No remote CI or physical device run
Controlled native play replacement proves rejection/late-completion handling, not autoplay permission or codec support
Cancellation fulfills with undefined, which signals settlement and does not prove source activation
customType keeps the original video and player; already-started external SDK work remains adapter-owned
Old URL revocation policy remains for CORE-19; reconnect generation remains CORE-11

discovery.issue: Actual playMix could overwrite a replacement source notice after a late native play resolution
discovery.reproduction: test/source.test.js real play mixin regression failed with actual Play versus expected latest notice before captureSource was added
discovery.resolution: Capture source identity in playMix, preserve native fulfillment/rejection, suppress obsolete notice/event/mutex effects
